business_problem: TELUS needed to unify siloed customer and network data so teams could trust the same foundation for generative AI, launch new services faster, and scale agentic platforms without each business unit building its own disconnected stack.
solution_summary: TELUS used Google Cloud to create a unified enterprise data and AI foundation centered on BigQuery and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. BigQuery became the shared source of truth for customer information and other operational data, supported by services such as Cloud SQL, BigQuery Analytics Hub, and Knowledge Catalog to improve sharing, discoverability, and governance. On top of that data layer, TELUS built Fuel iX on Google Cloud and now routes most AI model traffic through Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, using Model Garden to access Gemini, Claude, and other models from one managed environment. Gemini Enterprise Customer Experience extends the same platform into customer service, while the broader data foundation gives TELUS room to build secure identity services and self-healing network capabilities. The outcome is a more trusted, reusable AI platform where data unification and model flexibility reinforce each other instead of living in separate programs.
